scope: Selective discovery of unfamiliar homes under $1M across the Twin Cities metro. Public web listings and exact-address brokerage records, not an exhaustive MLS export.
criteria: Privacy and connection to outdoor space
regionsSearched: Hopkins, Minnetonka, Golden Valley, Orono, Excelsior and Chaska
Shoreview, Arden Hills, Fridley, New Brighton and White Bear Lake

added.why: Vaulted wood ceilings, stained glass, a brick fireplace and a library above the detached garage. Set among mature oaks on 0.71 acres.
added.tradeoffs: 3 bedrooms, 1½ baths. The woodwork and connection to the trees make this worth a visit. Access is by a private drive off Williston Road; check traffic noise and driveway rights. The current listing counts 3 bedrooms, with potential for a fourth.

added.why: Tall glass, a floating stair and warm wood cabinetry in a 2013 home based on Tim Alt plans, according to the listing. Near downtown Hopkins.
added.tradeoffs: 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Strong spatial design on a compact 0.14-acre lot; neighbors are close. Check evening noise near Mainstreet and the pending assessment flagged in the listing.

heldBack.whyInteresting: Low brick-and-glass 1961 house, preserved cabinetry and extensive lakeside setting. Strong architectural match.
heldBack.whyNotAdded: Specific historical flood-exposure concern needs current professional review. Only two bedrooms, no garage, and listing says floor-plan alterations require Rethos written approval.

evidence.note: MLS 7136109: 2 bedrooms, 2753 sqft, preservation easement and no garage.

heldBack.whyInteresting: Exposed beams, wood walls, original built-ins, broad glass gables and creek frontage.
